harness.role: orchestration layer above owner skills and deterministic scripts

global_experience_agent_entry.default_route: every Codex project entry starts or resumes Global Experience Agent durable work through agent/40-runtime/Invoke-GlobalExperienceAgent.ps1 after codex-self-evolution project entry unless the user explicitly authorizes a turn-level skip

startup_policy.skip_requires: explicit user authorization for this turn
skip_does_not_bypass: Codebase Memory F-codex startup and indexing when applicable
safety, privacy, rollback, and validation gates
startup_policy.authority_boundary: automatic Agent startup records durable work and retrieves relevant records only; it does not authorize Git, release, installation, credential, publication, destructive cleanup, top-owner, or Agent-structure mutation

applies_to: all Codex project entries by default unless explicit user-authorized skip
entry_protocol: retrieve relevant Agent memory when useful
classify Auto intent before operation permission evaluation
global_experience_agent_entry.transfer_rule: legacy skill-first global experience work is treated as a harness resource call; the skill remains the owner, but the harness owns entry state, resource selection, tool gates, and closeout

run_contract: record caller, model, compatible host, interface, and authority scope labels
deny unauthorized operations before durable session mutation
flush pending writes after tool result
commit accepted or interrupted save point
agent_runtime.continue_contract: an authorized caller or compatible model continues an idle session by id, updates caller/model history, retrieves durable records and child state, and executes one registered operation
agent_runtime.resume_contract: reconstruct from durable state across caller or model changes, mark unfinished non-idempotent operations interrupted, and resume only from a safe boundary
agent_runtime.abort_contract: clear steer and followUp, preserve nextTurn and pending writes, settle to idle, and persist the abort boundary
agent_runtime.privacy_contract: durable agent sessions and Agent memory stores are local ignored metadata and evidence; raw private sessions, credentials, and secrets never enter Git
agent_runtime.execution_rule: the agent invokes only registered local operations, classifies Auto requests through config/agent-intent-policy.json, creates an auditable autonomous capability_plan from config/agent-autonomous-capability-decision-policy.json, evaluates config/agent-interface-policy.json before side effects, resolves root, concept, specialist, and child agents through the agent registry, and routes gated or structural mutation through the named owner controller
agent_runtime.memory_contract: Agent memory uses a local SQLite/FTS5 store with typed memory classes, TTL, supersession, consolidation, and frozen snapshot rendering. It is exposed as a registered memory-as-skill functional unit through config/agent-memory-skill-policy.json: callers search before store when prior records may apply, use upsert or supersession instead of unbounded append, retrieve on demand instead of injecting the whole store, review complete memory-action traces at save points, and iterate the scaffold only through measured behavior. Human, LLM, and internal-functional-unit callers may use registered memory operations under current authority; structural changes to the memory system still require global-control and the agent_structure gate.

filesystem.rule: the agent directory is the physical Agent topology; generated manifests point to canonical owner resources and never copy owner implementations

agent_registry.concept_policy: compose existing owners without duplicating top-level skill ownership
agent_registry.child_policy: executable bounded children with durable state, evidence-bearing completion, merge verification, and cancellation
agent_registry.caller_model_policy: session identity is durable and independent of caller or model labels; labels never expand authority

connection_contract: every active registry owner has exactly one canonical owner node
every owner node resolves to its canonical skill resource
plane and stage match the architecture presentation mapping
every connection names a durable artifact and return event
every owner has incoming and outgoing handoffs
the complete owner graph is reachable from and can return to codex-self-evolution
tool-gated owners retain their registered gate and evidence-only routing never executes the side effect

resources.selection_policy: experience-first progressive disclosure with graph evidence when available
information_units: knowledge-vault/30-Knowledge/Cherry Studio Capability Routing and Durable Workflow Learning.md

phase_model.structural_mutation_rule: structural changes require idle or verified save-point boundaries
phase_model.snapshot_rule: runtime-like updates affect future routing snapshots and must not rewrite the evidence used by an active proof

runtime_config.getter_rule: reads return the latest harness configuration for future routing, not the in-flight proof snapshot
runtime_config.setter_rule: runtime-like changes made during a turn update the next snapshot at a save point and never rewrite the active evidence request

turn_snapshot.creation_rule: create one immutable decision snapshot for each bounded task turn or verification proof
turn_snapshot.save_point_refresh_rule: after assistant/tool-result completion, refresh future context/model/tool/resource state before another provider-like step

queue_operations.busy_rule: structural operations are rejected while busy; queue operations are accepted only at documented safe points
queue_operations.drain_rule: queue drains are ordered and evidence-bearing; failed queue notifications roll back or route to error feedback

write_shapes: candidate session entry without generated id
pending_session_writes.persistence_rule: accepted pending writes are durable before public success is reported
pending_session_writes.ordering_rule: agent-emitted messages and tool results are persisted before queued extension or lifecycle writes for that turn

tool_registry.read_update_semantics: tool reads expose current registry state; active-tool updates validate uniqueness, existence, owner, and authority before commit
tool_registry.persistence_rule: active tool changes are branch-scoped durable configuration when they affect future routing
tool_registry.rejection_rule: duplicate tool names, duplicate active names, invalid active tools, and ungated side effects are rejected

model_registry.provider_rule: providers own metadata, auth, model listing, and stream behavior; the harness selects models through a registry facade
model_registry.refresh_rule: model reads use last-known state; dynamic refresh is explicit, side-effect-free discovery
model_registry.auth_rule: auth failures remain visible and redacted; silent fallback after stored-credential failure is not allowed

hook_system.observer_rule: observers are passive and their returns are ignored
hook_system.handler_rule: result-producing handlers reduce by event-specific semantics such as transform chaining, patch accumulation, first cancel, or early block
hook_system.context_rule: hooks receive stable facades rather than raw internals or unordered session writes
hook_system.error_rule: hook failures after commit do not roll back committed state; they route through normalized harness or error-feedback handling

observability.adapter_rule: core lifecycle emits stable safe events; runtime adapters decide whether to bridge them to logs, OpenTelemetry, Sentry, or local reports
observability.redaction_rule: prompts, completions, tool args, tool results, shell output, file contents, headers, and secrets are unsafe by default

durable_recovery.host_restore_rule: the host recreates models, tools, resources, hooks, auth providers, and extension handlers before reducing durable state
durable_recovery.default_policy: mark unfinished provider requests and unsafe tool calls interrupted; retry only from durable boundaries or with owner-proven idempotency

session_entry_schema.tree_rule: entries form a branchable tree through id, parentId, and durable leaf movement
session_entry_schema.context_rule: compaction entries may carry retainedTail so newer checkpoints can rebuild context without walking stale raw history

effects: flush durable writes at save point, settlement, or failure cleanup
abort_semantics.barrier_rule: abort waits for safe settlement and never discards accepted durable writes

compaction_and_branching.structural_rule: compaction and tree navigation are idle-only structural mutations
compaction_and_branching.branch_summary_rule: branch summaries capture abandoned-branch context before navigation affects future turns
compaction_and_branching.auto_compaction_rule: auto-compaction remains a candidate until a deterministic decision point and no-regression tests exist

event_loop.output: bounded task contract with authority and quality floor
project authority, verified experience, graph evidence, and required skills
smallest accountable owner set and progressive-disclosure files
approved, denied, deferred, or evidence-only action
current-task evidence, failure report, or next bounded step
validated state, rollback boundary, and closeout evidence

exit_protocol: record tool results or error feedback
update lifecycle state or candidate records
generate current candidate report after complete global iterations
route Git, release, installation, credential, publication, and top-owner actions through their gates
emit a typed interface exit with the authority decision and next authority boundary
report residual risk and next authority boundary
agent_exit_alignment.alignment_rule: no global experience task is complete until its output, proof, lifecycle/candidate state, and any Git or publication boundary are aligned with the agent save point
agent_exit_alignment.handoff_rule: when work exits to a specialist owner, the handoff names inputs, authority, expected artifact, verification, rollback or blocked condition, and return event

human_review_and_evals.review_rule: human review pauses at authority boundaries, preserves durable state, and resumes only from an accepted decision or a clarified response
human_review_and_evals.eval_rule: agent behavior changes must have repeatable tests or dataset-like fixtures before they are treated as implemented functionality

session.tree_policy: metadata and evidence form a tree of resumable branches; raw private sessions and secrets stay out of Git

extensions.admission_gate: source review, trust scope, rollback, validation, and current authority

recovery.failure_route: structured error feedback before promotion or repeated repair

transport_failures.rule: known transport failures before completion stop automatic retry, persist state, and return a restart-required prompt
transport_failures.resume: restart Codex or the affected host, then Resume before Continue

host_watchdog.rule: Codex app snapshots with a stale inProgress turn and no output/tool event, or with a stale inProgress tool marker, return a restart-required prompt
host_watchdog.action: persist host-recovery marker and prompt without force-killing

required_conditions: registered specialist, concept, or child agent profile

named_profiles.delegation_rule: Global Experience Agent owns task/session/authority/save point; the child owns visual brief, visual route planning, design-system selection, route-specific artifact coordination, validation evidence, and reusable template return only.

structural_optimization_inheritance.profile_fit_summary: Adapt shared learning through visual-design-agent purpose, route-specific visual methods, reusable template artifacts, verifier, and authority boundary before execution.

named_profiles.delegation_rule: Global Experience Agent owns task/session/authority/save point; the child owns career/life planning route selection, onboarding checks, evidence-grounded drafts, validation, and return evidence only.

structural_optimization_inheritance.profile_fit_summary: Adapt shared learning through career-planning-agent purpose, allowed operations, owner resources, output artifacts, verifier, and authority boundary before execution.

subagents.authority_rule: delegation inherits but never expands the current authority snapshot
subagents.continuation_rule: child and parent state remain repository-local and caller/model neutral
subagents.transport_recovery: child transport failures write a restart-required durable state; JoinSubagent returns the prompt to the parent instead of waiting indefinitely

structural_optimization_propagation.adoption_rule: a verified Global Experience Agent learning optimization is incomplete until it is adapted to affected child profiles, improves a declared functional effect, and aligns template, registered profiles, projections, and delegation snapshots

constraints: single accountable controller
default deny
interface labels never elevate authority
human, llm, and internal units cannot directly mutate Agent structure
only explicitly authorized global-control can route structural mutation
no hidden runtime takeover
no structural mutation outside idle or verified save-point boundaries
busy structural operations reject synchronously
legacy global experience skill work enters as a harness resource call
prefer existing owners
all active owners remain reachable through the harness
evidence-only routing cannot execute a gated side effect
do not store raw private sessions or secrets
project facts stay project-local
no duplicate Owner Skill implementation
generated files stay below agent root
private local state stays outside agent root
legacy adapters remain forward-only
stale generated files are removed only by marker

required_protocols: structured error feedback on unexpected behavior
constraints: Git/release/install/credential/external/top-owner/agent-structure actions require their owning gates
successful controllers return machine-readable JSON when called by parent workflows
human-readable command output must be suppressed or captured before parent JSON results
invalid or duplicate active tools are rejected
raw private sessions stay out of Git
proof reuse requires exact HEAD and path-hash match
candidate-only proof cannot satisfy Git publication
accepted writes are not dropped on abort or failure cleanup
raw Pi extensions are not loaded by default
subagents require registered profiles and bounded authority
external runtimes require explicit current authority
observability subscribers are passive and redacted by default
rollback failure blocks mutation and Git
verification failure outside repair scope blocks completion
residual risk must be named
unfinished provider streams and unsafe tool calls are not retried automatically
no global experience task exits without proof/state alignment

settled_when: state changes are scoped and reviewable
reusable lessons are captured or consciously left as candidates
blocked_when: source evidence cannot be refreshed and local evidence is insufficient
verification fails outside the authorized repair scope
